items.name: bar-chart-race
items.title: Bar Chart Race
items.description: Ranked bars grow and overtake each other as a time series advances, with the axis rescaling as values climb and the accent handing over to whoever leads

variables.label: Series (one per line: Name: v1, v2, ...)

items.name: before-after-wipe
items.title: Before After Wipe
items.description: Two full-bleed content slots compare before and after states as a persistent divider wipes the after layer over the before layer and rests at a configurable split. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

variables.label: Before label
variables.description: Chip shown on the base before panel. Blank hides the chip.

variables.label: After label
variables.description: Chip shown on the revealed after panel. Blank hides the chip.

variables.label: Resting split
variables.description: Divider resting position after the wipe lands.

variables.label: Wipe start
variables.description: Seconds after mount start when the wipe begins.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Divider handle and after chip color.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. None holds the final comparison frame.

items.name: chart-story
items.title: Chart Story
items.description: One chart builds from data in reading order and lands the exact supplied values: staggered bars, a left-to-right line with area fill, a sweeping donut, or filling progress bars, with an accented value callout on the emphasized datum.

variables.label: Chart type
variables.description: Chart form the data builds into.

variables.label: Data
variables.description: Comma-separated numbers; the chart lands exactly on these values.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Comma-separated labels, one per datum.

variables.label: Emphasize
variables.description: Index of the datum that takes the accent and the value callout. Clamped to the data range.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Suffix appended to every displayed value.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the emphasized datum and its callout.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Proof stats end on the still hold, so the default is none.

items.name: conic-progress-ring
items.title: Conic Progress Ring
items.description: A token-driven conic progress ring whose angular fill and center count settle together from one registered percentage.

variables.label: Progress
variables.description: Target angular fill from 0 to 100.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Ring stroke thickness as a percent of the ring radius.

variables.label: Center label
variables.description: Numeric target shown in the center and counted in sync with the fill.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: A token-native stat counter that eases between values, counting up or down, and lands with a restrained scale pulse.

variables.label: Start value
variables.description: First value shown by the count.

variables.label: End value
variables.description: Final value where the count lands.

variables.label: Prefix
variables.description: Optional text shown before the value.

variables.label: Suffix
variables.description: Optional text shown after the value.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by the count.

variables.label: Glow
variables.description: Optional soft accent glow under the count. Off by default.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the landed value holds until the frame cuts.

items.name: decline-chart
items.title: Decline Chart
items.description: A metric line draws downward as its value counts down and the ambient background darkens in lockstep.

variables.label: Metric label
variables.description: Label shown above the declining value.

variables.label: Start value
variables.description: Metric value at the start of the decline.

variables.label: End value
variables.description: Metric value at the bottom of the decline.

items.name: mk-usage-arc
items.title: Hairline Arc Gauge
items.description: Thin circular gauge that draws on while its percentage counts up; one helper call drives both

items.name: star-rating-fill
items.title: Star Rating Fill
items.description: A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.

variables.label: Rating
variables.description: Target rating in star units from 0 to 5.

variables.label: Star count
variables.description: Number of stars shown in the row.

variables.label: Show value
variables.description: Show or hide the synchronized numeric rating.

items.name: data-chart
items.title: Data Chart
items.description: Animated bar + line chart with staggered reveal, NYT-style typography, and value labels

items.name: flowchart-vertical
items.title: Flowchart Vertical
items.description: Portrait animated decision tree with SVG connectors, sticky-note nodes, cursor interaction, and typing correction

items.name: flowchart
items.title: Flowchart
items.description: Animated decision tree with SVG connectors, sticky-note nodes, cursor interaction, and typing correction

items.name: hw-pipeline
items.title: Hand-Drawn Flowchart
items.description: Wobbled boxes with handwritten labels joined by curved connectors, drawing on in sequence from a node list

items.name: mk-line-graph
items.title: Minimal Line Graph
items.description: One or two SVG series draw on with dots popping and value labels riding the draw front; dim baseline axis, x-labels, color-dot legend

items.name: mk-progress-stat
items.title: Count-Up Stat Card
items.description: Big-numeral statistic with count-up, label, thin progress track filling to value/max, and caption; light and dark schemes

items.name: oscilloscope-trace
items.title: Oscilloscope Trace
items.description: CRT oscilloscope beam sweeping a waveform across a 10x8 graticule, with closed-form phosphor persistence: the tail decays as exp(-age/tau) and brightens where the beam slows

items.name: world-map
items.title: World Map
items.description: Animated world choropleth with country-by-country reveal, tooltip labels, and rotating globe inset — D3 Natural Earth projection
